decisions.reason: The date-control scope change is independently stated in the date-functionality section and is already represented; expanding placeholder-clearing scope does not alter the date-entry method.
Text wrapping and column stability are independently specified in the same message and are not changed by extending placeholder-clearing behavior to additional templates.
Board Seminar multiline input is a separate behavior established by its own clause; placeholder clearing does not change its input method or scope.
The source decision does not mention or change checklist and dropdown configuration.
Extending the contexts for automatic placeholder clearing does not necessarily change the established field architecture or editable-text mechanism.
The label and help-text requirement already covers every interactive field, and the source does not change its content, persistence, locations, or generic scope.
Hard-return spacing is independently specified in the same message and is unaffected by the placeholder-clearing scope expansion.
The source changes where placeholder clearing applies but does not alter the Danish labels or placeholder strings.
Placeholder clearing in Guidance and Board Seminar does not entail any change to Title-field formatting preservation.
Automatic clearing upon field activation can coexist with instructional text identifying an otherwise empty field; the source does not change the visual-cue requirement.
Guidance margin behavior is independently specified in the same message and is not affected by extending automatic placeholder clearing to Guidance.
The placeholder-clearing scope change does not modify Enter-key bullet creation behavior.
